items.title: Stocks Rally as Oil Drops on Hormuz Diplomatic Hopes
items.summary: Brent crude fell almost 5% on hopes of reopening the Strait of Hormuz, while U.S. stock indexes posted strong gains.  Iran said Monday that there weren’t any talks under way with the U.S. nor were any meetings planned, after President Trump said the day before he had called off a major strike on the country to provide more time for negotiations.  The Nasdaq jumped 2.1%, the S&P 500 rose 1.5%, and the Dow industrials gained 1.3%.
